hooks.command: f=/tmp/.wxcli-agent-active; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; t=$(mktemp); tail -n +2 "$f" > "$t"; mv "$t" "$f"; [ -s "$f" ] || rm -f "$f"

input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); f=/tmp/.wxcli-agent-active; if [ -f "$f" ]; then t=$(mktemp); while IFS= read -r p; do [ -n "$p" ] && kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null && echo "$p"; done < "$f" > "$t"; mv "$t" "$f"; [ -s "$f" ] || rm -f "$f"; fi; first=$(echo "$cmd" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+)*//' | awk '{print $1}'); if [ "$first" = "wxcli" ] && [ ! -s "$f" ]; then jq -nc --arg c "$cmd" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("wxcli commands must go through the wxc-calling-builder agent. REQUIRED ACTION: Do NOT attempt to run wxcli directly again. Instead, spawn the wxc-calling-builder agent (subagent_type=\"wxc-calling-builder\") and pass it this intent: " + $c + " — The agent handles auth, planning, execution, and verification. Only exception: the user explicitly asks you to run a raw CLI command for debugging.")}}'; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi
